notes: Customer: Lattice builds JetBrains plugins (IntelliJ/PyCharm) that do on-device indexing + cloud-assisted completions.
Main ask: low-latency streaming completions -> sub-100ms RTT for single-token followups on typical dev machine.
They want a hybrid flow: local code index (search/parse) + Redwood-hosted LM for completion and reasoning. local index should never leave machine (privacy req).
Quote: 'We need completions to feel native — streaming, incremental, model pinning per plugin version.'
Key technical constraints: offline-first UX, small prefix window for privacy, fallback to cached completions when connectivity lost.
Billing concern: how token billing is applied for streaming partial tokens and local cache hits. Lattice asks for deterministic cost model for in-editor micro-interactions.
Security ask: SSO for org admin panel, audit logs for every model/prompt invocation, optional KMS for customer-managed keys, and regional data residency for EU customers.
Recommended Redwood fit: Private (VPC) for enterprise customers, Hosted API with Optimize suggestions for SMB plugin users; model pinning to guarantee plugin behavior across releases.
Integration notes: plugin SDK will call Redwood streaming endpoint via an edge gateway; need an offline SDK shim that consults local index first and flips to cloud API only when heuristics trigger.
POC scope proposed: 6-week POC to validate latency on dev machines, demo model pinning + rollout (canary) inside plugin update flow.
